invariants.rationale: The table type must be defined for switch-case; null would likely result in a runtime exception.
config is directly passed into constructors and is likely required to be non-null.
context is directly passed into constructors and is expected to be non-null.
metaClient is dereferenced and used for method calls, so it must not be null.
Only COPY_ON_WRITE and MERGE_ON_READ are explicitly handled by the switch; other types cause an exception.
